        self.branch_b.classifier = nn.Identity()

            nn.Linear(self.branch_a.num_features + self.branch_b.num_features, 512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 1),

        b_features = self.branch_b(x[:, [1, 3, 5]])
        combined = torch.cat([a_features, b_features], dim=1)
